title: Installing Unity Hub & Editor
description: Download, install, and configure the Unity Hub and your first Editor version.

slides.title: Unity Hub: Your Command Center 🖥️
slides.content:
# What is Unity Hub?

The **Unity Hub** is a standalone application that manages your Unity installations, projects, and licenses.

*   It lets you install multiple Editor versions side by side.
*   You can create new projects or open existing ones from one place.
*   Download it from [unity.com/download](https://unity.com/download).

quizData.question: What does the Unity Hub allow you to do?

options.text: Manage multiple Unity Editor installations and projects

quizData.explanation: The Unity Hub is the launcher and version manager for the Unity ecosystem.

slides.title: Installing the Editor 📦
slides.content:
# Installing a Unity Version

1.  Open Unity Hub and go to the **Installs** tab.
2.  Click **Add** and choose a version (the latest LTS is recommended for beginners).
3.  Select modules: **Microsoft Visual Studio** (for scripting) and build support for your target platform (e.g., Windows, Mac, WebGL).
4.  Wait for the download and installation to finish.

slides.title: ⚠️ Important Note
slides.content:
## Enough Disk Space

A full Unity installation can take **5-10 GB**. Make sure you have free space before installing. Also, stable internet is needed to download the modules.

slides.title: Pro Tip 🚀
slides.content:
## LTS vs Tech Stream

*   **LTS (Long Term Support)** – best for beginners and production; receives bug fixes for two years.
*   **Tech Stream** – has the latest features but may be less stable.
